clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the Barrens' Lushwater Oasis, the Wailing Caverns are named for the eerie whistle of trapped steam. Their maze of underground springs and fissures was meant to revive Kalimdor's sun-bleached savanna, a noble druidic effort. Now it is a warped, poisonous underworld, teeming with twisted wildlife and fallen disciples in the grip of a deep, unnatural nightmare.

The night elf druid Naralex found this vast water system and devised an ambitious plan. Through a conduit into the Emerald Dream, he would draw pure primal life through the springs and turn the parched Barrens back into a thriving paradise. Deep in the caverns, anchored by his loyal acolytes, Naralex slipped into communion with the Dream. But his sleeping mind touched the Emerald Nightmare instead. The corruption seized him at once, and his conduit became a valve pouring venom and madness into the underground waters.

As the Nightmare's dark energy radiated from Naralex's helpless form, his students fell to the madness. They forsook the tranquil wisdom of the Cenarion Circle and became the fanatical Druids of the Fang. Their leaders, Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, Lord Pythas and Lord Serpentis, take reptilian forms and embrace the venomous mutation of the caverns instead of fighting it. They shield their sleeping master from any outside interference, convinced this twisted growth is nature's true evolution.
